reviews.text: Dr. Hanks and the entire team at Rose Canyon are fantastic. They love the animals and all my dogletts have loved them. Top quality animal care.

We had a great experience in Rose Canyon Animal Hospital. And are choosing this place as a main location for the veterenary facility for our new pet. All the staff are very friendly, caring and professional.
My 3yo Great Dane has been coming here for years. We had her spay + gastropexy done here without any issues or complications. The vets are always kind to us. I recommend 10/10 times!
All of the staff at Rose Canyon are extremely kind and knowledgeable.  We saw Dr Vanessa on our last visit and she was wonderful.  Thank you.

After consultation with other vets, the vet at Rose Canyon answered all my questions and provided the care my dog needed. The office staff were caring and helpful, the vet was fabulous, highly recommend this practice for your pets.

Love both of these vets! And their staff are GREAT!  I have had Dr Hoard care for my complicated hairless Mexican Xóloitzcuintlie since I moved back to San Diego in 2022. Thanks for caring so much( it's obvious it's real!) Hugs! Charlynn Forbes
Very professional and helped look after my nervous cat

Rose Canyon Animal Hospital treated our dog, Maverick, for CCL surgery, and from the moment we made the first appointment through his final visit, the entire experience was exceptional. Every single person—from the receptionists and vet techs to the doctor who sat on the floor with us for 45 minutes explaining the surgery, and even the surgeon—was absolutely wonderful.

Maverick is our four-legged child, so trusting someone with his care meant everything to us. They treated him with so much compassion and made sure we understood everything throughout the entire process.

We currently have a vet closer to our home, but after our experience with Rose Canyon, we’ve decided to make them our regular veterinarian from now on. Hands down, I highly recommend Rose Canyon Animal Hospital.
Dr. Hoard excellent!
Techs and vets are always very helpful and explains everything throughly.
Another locally owned clinic lost to private equity. This place was the best when owned by Dr. Michael, don’t be fooled by the older reviews.
Im Local Clairemont area and have been to 3 orhr local vets and I have found the service care and genuine quality of service has been at Rose Canyon. I will NEVER go anywhere else!

They are very liberal in their use of heavy sedatives for pets getting x-rays with any amount of perceived energy. I've gotten x-rays done of my dog in the past at other vets, including their so called sister vet ABC, and never had to get such heavy sedatives for simple x ray scans. It resulted in my dog whining for 6-8 hours straight.

I also didn't like the lack of communication from staff, where after coming up with a plan for treatment for my dog, I was told to maybe go to Costco or something and wasn't given really any timeline. Ended up waiting 3-4 hours, until then receiving my heavily sedated whining dog and then waiting for another hour to have the veterinarian come out and discuss findings infront of everyone in the lobby. I would have much rather preferred the discussion be within the privacy of an exam room rather than the hustle and bustle of the waiting lobby and people coming in and out. This wasn't an environment where I was adequately able to process or ask important questions.
Thank you!

The team at Rose Canyon always goes above and beyond for my pets. If I could give them more than
five stars, I would! My dog has seen Dr. Hanks for a couple years now and he's always been very caring and knowledgeable about her issues. I also brought in a new puppy for a wellness check and the puppy felt instantly comfortable around him and the rest of the vet techs. Their pricing is also very transparent and fair. I also love their business hours as it's easy to make an appointment and get seen after a typical work day or weekends.

The vets and team at Rose Canyon are absolutely amazing and true professionals. They truly care and went out of their way to care for French bulldog who needed an ear hematoma surgery. They did an incredible job on the surgery in every way possible. We are very particular about our little guy and we had no concerns what so ever after meeting the vet and staff.

I brought my pug in for a checkup, and from the front desk to the vet tech and then Dr Hanks we were treated as if we were VIPs.
Dr Hanks sat on the floor with us as we discussed the growth on Poppy's gums.. allowing her to sniff and kiss him!  He came up with a reasonable affordable game plan that has solved the problem!

I definitely recommend this vet I ended up here because Deni works here who is a friend of mine . I don’t live anywhere near here but it’s worth the drive. Dr Hanks is so sweet and kind. He takes his time and it doesn’t feel rushed at all.
Dr. Hanks is amazing, so through and knowledgeable.   I dont feel over charged for unnecessary procedures.  The staff is professional and caring.
Great service! Professional and friendly from technician to vet. I will bring my dogs back.
Marceline has a great support team at Rose Canyon!
We have a great experience with Spring fka Waffle.

Our elderly cat started having issues a few weeks ago. Our normal vet couldn't see her same day, our backup vet couldn't see her. But they recommended Rose Canyon.

I called Rose Canyon and they got our kitty in right away. All of the staff were so kind. Dr. Hanks saw our cat. He was so empathetic in his care for her. He discussed several different options for next steps of care, but most importantly he cared about her well-being and our concerns of how to best care for her. I have had previous vets who have guilted and pressured for every expensive test they could think of, which isn't always the most compassionate or realistic approach for the well-being of the animal or the human.  Especially when it comes to elderly animals.

I was very grateful Dr Hanks was compassionate and didnt pressure or guilt about any of that. He discussed the pressing concerns (an infection), concerns related to aging, and paths we could take for follow up.

Thank you!

Also, our cat loved their scale lol.

My dog had an eye infection on a Sunday. Very few places offer urgent care for animals. However, I found out Rose Canyon Animal Hospital offered this service. The appt., was easy to make. They were friendly and saw him right away. The whole procedure from start to finish was pretty quick. I would definitely recommend Rose Canyon to other pet owners, especially if you have an emergency on a weekend.

Dr Hanks is a very caring and knowledgeable vet. I always request him to treat my not -so-nice  feral cat, Taz. He’s calm and Taz responds well with him. Thank you Dr Hanks for taking exceptional care of Taz.

I have had nothing but phenomenal experiences with Rose Canyon Animal Hospital. All vets are extremely attentive and take the time with you and your animal to ensure both are comfortable. Could not recommend enough!
Thank you!

We have been seeing Dr. Hanks at Rose Canyon and we really like him.  We had a bit of an emergency with one of our pups today and he got us in and was very helpful.  I like that he does not "push" treatments and explains everything, sometimes way over my head.  But I trust him completely.
Great Animal hospital! All the doctors are great in caring for our girls
Dr. Hank is the best! He really knows what he is doing and I can tell he really cares for animals and animals like him too!

My experience was great! Clean clinic, friendly staff and another professional opinion regarding my pug.
Dr. Hoard listened to my concerns and gave me insight, and developed a treatment plan.
Thanks Rose Canyon and staff
Brenda Allick

I highly recommend Rose Canyon Animal Hospital.  Dr. Sanabria is very caring and compassionate.  She is thorough and doesn’t rush thru an exam and doesn’t suggest unnecessary tests.  She is very gentle with my dog. Her technician Yaudel is also very thorough, helpful , and extremely good with my dog.  The staff are all great at Rose Canyon!

Today was my cat's 4th clinic visit & first time with Dr. Hoard. So far, two DVM doctors have superceded my expectations. Easy to understand explanations and directions were provided . Also the friendly & professional service absolutely extends to the support staff as well.

They absolutely are like no other Vet!! I switched after going somewhere else for 8 years! They offer urgent care appointments and genuinely want to help and care for your animal. I know my chihuahua is going to get the best care as she goes into her later years. They are the best!

Rose Canyon Veterinary Hospital is the best place in San Diego that I have experienced having my dogs taken care off. From the moment you walk in, the young loving staff that checks u in, to the wonderful very knowledgeable and caring Doctor Horn, frankly all around 5 stars experience.
Wonderful and caring doctors and staff.  Dr. Hoard and Dr. Sanabra are very nice, knowledgeable and approachable. I recommend their office 100%.

My dog Enzo, was having difficulty breathing after inhaling something. I called Thursday about 10:15 and the front desk person was very attentive and checked with the Vet on duty. I was able to bring him right in and Dr. Sanabria examined Enzo and was able to determine whatever he inhaled had dislodged and his vital signs were stable. Thank you for the excellent service.  I will be back to have his teeth cleaned in 2 weeks.

Shout out to Dr. Jurak, Dr. Sanabria and the amazing staff at Rose Canyon Animal Hospital for taking care of my sweet boy Pinto and saving his life. They were quick, attentive and super caring when he urgently needed surgery. The care they provide is super affordable, and the professional here is top notch.

We stumbled across Rose Canyon Animal Hospital due to a necessary FHO surgery for Charlie with the highly recommended resident surgeon, Dr. Denmer. We couldn't be anymore happy with the service and care the expert team provided Charlie. We met with Dr. Hanks who provided a thorough review and consultation before surgery. All associated costs were itemized and transparent. Dr. Demner called immediately after surgery to provide thorough post-op instructions. It's such a relief to have this level of communication during a time of fear and uncertainty.

It just so happened that Socks also needed urgent attention after showing lethargic behavior and refusing to eat after a couple of days. We were able to book an appointment the same day as Charlie's surgery. Their scheduling availabilities saved us from having to take multiple trips and he received the same attentive care as Charlie from Dr. Hanks.

It's quite impressive to be in the presence of a great team. Rose Canyon Animal Hospital is fully staffed with experts and fully equipped to run x-rays, special surgeries, and complete blood work panels. We learned so much about how to care for our fur babies from just one day and we strongly feel that we should transition the rest of the fur babies to Rose Canyon Animal Hospital as our primary vet.
Seems to be a great place for surgery, especially for old and/or medically complex dogs
couldn't ask for better service that i got today. Rose Canyon Animal Hospital is the absolute best.

I trust the entire staff here is working in my best interest and know (from multiple experiences) that they will work with me to make sure I’m caring for my pet the best I can. I couldn’t recommend them enough.

My dog had started getting bloody diarrhea and vomiting blood. I took him in on Wednesday since this was the only vet in San Diego we had seen since moving here and we were seen by Dr. Sanabria who did an X-ray and gave him fluids and insisted he was having an allergic food reaction and wrote us a prescription for a new food. After 2 days my dogs condition quickly worsened and I brought him back here (my mistake) that day Dr. Alexa Jurak said she wanted to do another X-ray on him. I let the vet tech and her know that he was very dehydrated and he needed an ultrasound. Fastforward to 6 hours later and Dr. Jurak calls me saying my dog might still have an obstruction and he needed to be transferred to the hospital. When I went back to pick up my dog in critical condition it took them over an hour to have him ready for transport. I wish they would have told me in the beginning that his condition was critical and he needed to be in a hospital even before they agreed to see him. He was very sedated and overall looked terrible and had to be carried out to the car by my brother in law and female vet tech. Once transferred to the hospital the vet (Dr. Michael Wishnack) stated he didn't have any of my dog's test results even though Rose Canyon assured me they knew we were coming and sent the hospital his records. So after showing the vet my dog's invoice from Rose Canyon he wondered why no blood work was repeated since his condition had deteriorated so much since the last time he was in and he also let me know that Rose Canyon had not given my dog any IV fluids even though he had an IV in and he was having profuse bloody diarrhea. All they gave him were very strong sedatives. Dr. Wishnack insisted that the chance of my dog having an obstruction was very low considering 2 x rays were already performed at Rose Canyon. My dog ended up being diagnosed with hemorrhagic gastroenteritis from pancreatitis which requires around the clock care and is life threatening. Considering how common this condition is in dogs I couldn't believe that neither of the vets at Rose Canyon brought this up as a possible issue and they downplayed how serious his condition actually was. My dog very well could have died and is still in very critical condition. I am so sad at the way they took care of my dog and I will never be back. Please avoid this place and these doctors. Dr. Jurak also works at/ owns the WAG animal hospital where my dog was transferred to. I do not recommend her at all but do recommend Dr. Wishnack.

My diabetic and blind dog gets the best care, great attention to detail, excellent communication with me, they always take the time to explain and to answer my questions or hear my concerns about what's going on with my dog and his condition. They're very welcoming, very accommodating for scheduling, and they respond fairly quickly when I use their website to request an appointment. A lot of people who used to bring their pets to Dr Michael, prior owner now retired, are bringing their pets and appear very pleased with the care their fur babies are receiving.  I think they're a great team of doctors, technicians, assistants, and staff. I respect and trust their advice and treatment of my fur baby, Boo Boo.
I really liked Dr. Hoard's caring and compassionate manner. She also gives options knowing that with an older dog, for us, it's about quality of life balance.
Thank you for your review. We appreciate you choosing us for your pet’s care and look forward to seeing you again.
Excellent for all three of my cats and one small dog.

Where do I begin… They are the best! At the time my baby was seeing Dr Michael.  I have been coming here for over 25 years. When my dog passed  i was devastated, the staff was incredible!!! One of the ladies asked if she could give me a hug, (Danny, who is no longer there) of course you can i told her. I cried in her arms and she just let me cry😭 I then found out later when i got a letter that Dr.Michael had made a donation to the humane society in my babies name 😭😭😭 she was my EVERYTHING and they helped me through it all. All those i speak of are gone. I have experienced the new doctors and they are wonderful and the staff continues to be so nice and helpful and the staff at the front desk… they get five ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I now see Dr. Hoard, she was so wonderful when my cat passed away of 21 years & now she takes care of my other cat and he is a handful and doesn’t like the vet so it’s always rough but when Dr. Hoard comes in he gets calm and lets her do what she needs too. She just did a surgery on him and he is doing so great and the whole staff there took such good care of him. Even changing hands in ownership never changed the care they give to my babies and the prices are still very reasonable!!!

Really attentive kind patient staff and Dr.. They were Kind enough to get us in same day as my dog was having a bladder flare up. Dr went out of her way to discuss things with my dogs Urologist and ruled out some things I had worried about myself. I will say they are a bit more expensive then my regular vet for testing items blood UTI etc but that should not over shadow how amazing this vet office is. Side note the dental pricing was very reasonable so we will see them for that as well.
Excellent experience again! Dr Vanessa Hoard and Team were professional, courteous and timely! Much appreciated! Thank you..
Very friendly and professional staff! My dog likes them

Absolutely best Vet Care I’ve ever experienced!  Staff is so kind and always compassionate.  Most importantly, I’m not the only one, as each and every customer I’ve met in the appointment area/waiting room are the kindest people!!! They manage their furry children well and follow rules! No raucous or fear and also very kind to the staff! A+++++
The staff is lovely, and my dogs have great experiences each time we visit. Thank you for taking such good care of my besties! I’ve been with Rose Canyon for about 10 years. 💗🐾 …

They are the best! Kind, compassionate and caring. We were using another vet who were not responsive or communicative but we will be sticking with Rose Canyon from now on. The team were fantastic, even on a Sunday and we owe so much to them for saving our baby Rockets eye.

Rose Canyon Veterinarian Clinic is wonderful.  Dr Hoard took care of “Molly”when she was very ill.  She was compassionate and caring.  Dr Hoard diagnosed Molly with Addison’s Disease.  The treatment that was necessary and ongoing was a monthly injection of Percorten and a steroid in pill form every other day. The technicians are awesome as they personally go that extra mile and come out to my car for her.  Molly is a bit unruly and not very sociable (but very sweet).  Rose Canyon Veterinarian Clinic is by far one of the best places for pet care.  I highly recommend them.  Their staff is superb.!
We love this animal hospital. The staff are so welcoming and very helping in making sure you and your pet are comfortable. I bring both my dogs here and every time we all leave happier and healthier.
First timer here but they were great and took care of our needs!  Office is super clean, and the staff is great at communicating needs.

My husband and I had the best experience at Rose Canyon Animal Hospital on Sunday, 12/28/2025, and felt compelled to share because they truly made our first ER visit as pet parents so much less intense and overwhelming.

Finding out that our 5-year-old first fur baby, Smokey, was peeing blood completely shook me. My heart sank and I felt instant panic, fear, and anxiety. As pet parents, it’s terrifying not knowing what’s happening and how serious it could be. After some research and advice from a friend, we knew blood in the urine and frequent litter box trips can sometimes signal a urinary issue that needs urgent attention, so we rushed him in immediately.

My husband found Rose Canyon Animal Hospital on Google, and we went straight there that morning. We noticed a sign on the door that said “Sunday ER visits by appointment only,” but we went in anyway hoping they could help. Thankfully, they saw Smokey right away. As my husband said, they earned our future business for life right then and there. He later shared that online estimates were showing anywhere from $800–$1,200 for even a basic ER visit and much higher for more serious cases, so we were incredibly relieved with both the care and transparency around pricing.

The moment we walked in, we were greeted by a kind and compassionate receptionist who immediately picked up on how worried I was. Her warmth alone helped calm me down. She asked a few quick questions, had us fill out a short form, and within minutes Smokey was taken back for a physical exam and initial diagnostics before we were brought into a room.

Before the doctor came in, a team member walked us through Smokey’s initial exam findings. She was clear, thorough, and reassuring, letting us know there were no immediate signs pointing to a urinary blockage, which was a huge relief. I got emotional, and she met that moment with genuine empathy and understanding. She even offered Smokey his first Churu treats and let him roam freely in the room instead of staying in his carrier, which made a big difference for both him and us.

When Dr. Alonso Byron came in, he was incredibly gentle, calm, and knowledgeable. He even had Smokey purring during the exam — which says everything. You could truly tell how much he loves what he does and cares about his patients.

From start to finish, the entire team made what could have been a terrifying ER experience feel manageable, compassionate, and supportive. We are so grateful for the care Smokey received and are confident we’ve found our long-term vet for all of our fur babies.

Thank you so much to the entire Rose Canyon team for taking such great care of Smokey — and us. 🤍🐾

The new veterinarian I’ve met her name was Seniarbia was very knowledgeable very nice and very quick service. I liked her very much and the receptionist and the crew and the price. Thank you very much for your service. Sincerely, Lucy. Genie’s mom
The vets and staff here are very warm and welcoming, and they really appear to care for your pet. I wouldn’t  hesitate to bring my pet here.

We had an excellent experience with Dr. Cory Hanks and would highly recommend Rose Canyon Animal Hospital to anyone. They are knowledgeable, patient and attentive to our concerns and care for our fur baby.

I was worried about my dog, I called Rose Canyon Vet, Hospital and they had an appt. that day at 2:30. They are the kindest and most understanding staff. I appreciate them so much! My dog doesn't like other dogs, the staff made arrangements for us to come in and go right to the exam room. I can't thank them enough! Dodie my dog, even gave Dr. Hoard kisses. We get the test results back in a couple of days.  I give them 10 stars!!!!

Thank you to the entire team at rose canyon, but especially Dr.Sanabria who helped save my dog Peanut last Friday. Her and the team diagnosed an emergent problem with my dog, called around at 4 different emergency vets to get all the needed info on the surgery needed, and quickly coordinated with the emergency vet so that when we arrived, Peanut was fast tracked to the procedure. Without their quick diagnostics and coordination she might not have made it.

Even before this incident I've had only positive experiences with the vets and staff at rose canyon. The front desk staff are always very kind and communicative, and have helped me sort out a wide range of problems in person and over the phone. Through helping get my other dog on a much needed anxiety medication regimen to fixing his absessed tooth - I am so grateful we chose rose canyon as our vet.
Dr. Hanks was incredibly informative and offered a detailed plan for my cat Kya. All staff were kind and caring.
They have changed a lot for the better since we started coming here 10 years ago.  Nice staff, good vets. Good service.

Today I was thinking I would have to put her to sleep, This is it she’s just had enough. I mean, she is 24 years old. I took her in to make sure there’s nothing else that Could be done for her…And there is! Came home with three medications And hope for some more time together. I know for sure that my kitty actually likes this place and these people. And that is a wonderful thing!
Very friendly and helpful

Dr Vanessa Hoard is a fantastic Vet. She's caring, professional and knowledgeable.  She's the reason I continue to come here, since Dr Michael retired. The staff is excellent, as well, providing a warm welcome and thorough assessment.
*As a suggestion, the prices for medications are not competitive and tend to be on the higher end of retail. Ask for prescriptions you can fill at Costco or other online outlets.
Rose Canyon Animal Hospital is the very best.  The entire staff is friendly, knowledgeable, etc.  Dr. Hanks is excellent.  When our pets (dogs) love him I know we have chosen the best for their care.

Rose Canyon Animal Hospital was able to get us in for a same-day appointment for an issue with our dog. Staff was super friendly and helpful, the doctor was able to identify the issue and prescribe us medication and get us on our way. Affordable with a great quality of care--will definitely go back to Rose Canyon for any urgent emergencies or situations where our regular vet can't get us in.

This is an awsom veterinary hospital.  On Oct 2nd I took my dog Whiskey into Rose Canyon Vet urgent care due to vomiting as well as a few other symptoms. I saw Dr Hanks he was very nice.
After examining Whiskey( my dog) We made a care plan, that included a sonogram and that tech would be able to see Whiskey later that day,so I left Whiskey and went home waited for them to call me with results. Unfortuneately the results were not good and quite unexpected. He had a tumor on his liver and galbladder was very enlarged with possibility of rupturing. Thier were 2 options, an emergency surgery  with a speciality vet$12,000 with no gaurantee of outcome, or uthanise.(also Whiskey was 13 yrs. old.)  I'm Sharing this story because even though I  decideded uthanise I  had  the most amazing
experience due to Dr. Hanks and  Staff. They put me in a private room and allowed me as much time as I  needed to say goodbye.I  let them know when I was ready and stayed through the whole process. Dr Hanks was wonderful, he showed so much compassion and understanding it was amazing. I  totally was at peace even though it was very sad and difficult for me. I know Rose Canyon Animal hospital was the right choice.  Losing our fur babies is the worst and  Dr Hanks kindness
and caring heart helped me make it through this difficult process. His staff was also very nice and friendly. I would highly recommend Rose Canyon Animal hospital to anyone who needs care for their pets. Amazing place!

They were so attentive and comforting at a time where I was fearful that my cat might not make it through his ordeal. He is great and I know it had everything to do with the expertise, love and attention they gave him!!
Dr Hoard is great with our dog! She talks with us about our pets care, not as at. Everyone there is friendly and knowledgeable. I definitely recommend taking your pet there!

We’ve been bringing all of our pets, both cats and dogs, to Rose Canyon Animal Hospital for years. They’ve helped us through some tough times, including the heartbreaking moment when we had to say goodbye to one of our fur babies. Unfortunately, since the hospital was bought out, the compassion, trust, and care we once felt are completely gone.

Our most recent visit was for our French Bulldog, Maverick, who came in with a lame leg. After X-rays showed no fractures, the technician, Cory Hanks, DVM, told us Maverick needed a TPLO surgery right away or he’d never be the same. The quote was $4,300, and they urged us to move quickly. We left with some medication and received just one follow-up call the next day, then nothing.

Out of concern, we sought a second and third opinion. Both other vets said surgery was absolutely not needed. They reviewed the same X-rays and determined it was likely a bruise or soft-tissue injury. Within days, Maverick was back to normal—running, jumping, and playing like nothing ever happened.

What really bothers me is realizing that several of our friends and family members had been told almost identical stories about “needing” the same surgery. When the technician bragged about performing 10–12 of these surgeries a week, that should’ve been a red flag.

Sadly, this clinic no longer feels like it’s about caring for animals. It feels like it’s about selling procedures. The front desk staff was also dismissive and seemed bothered when I called with questions. It’s taken me a few weeks to write this, but I feel it’s important to warn others.

Please be cautious. Get a second opinion before agreeing to anything major. I wish we’d never gone through this experience.
The vets and techs at Rose Canyon Animal Hospital are so kind and caring.   They really care about the animals they see.  My little doggie feels so comfortable when he goes there.

I’ve been a pet owner for over 20 years, and I can honestly say this is the best veterinary team I’ve ever worked with. From the doctors to the staff, everyone is incredibly kind, communicative, and genuinely loving toward the animals in their care.

My cat, Coco, had a terrible accident—she fell three stories and broke her leg, requiring surgery with pins placed in her bones. It was terrifying, but Rose Canyon made me feel safe and confident every step of the way. They treated Coco as if she were their own and gave her excellent care. Dr Hanks is incredible!

What also stood out is how transparent they are about pricing. They explain everything clearly, and they don’t tack on unnecessary charges. That kind of honesty builds real trust.

I’m so grateful to this hospital and the people who work there. They truly mean the world to me, and I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate, trustworthy veterinary care.
Clean environment. Friendly staff. Clear communication. Patient doctors (even with my super spicy cat); esp. Dr. Hanks!

Super awesome experience with Rose Canyon with our cat and chinchilla. The staff is super sweet. Dr Hoard and Lyn were thorough and handled our pets well despite them not loving the vet. Would recommend to anyone ~~

My cats have been in to see 3 of the doctors who work here, and they were all incredible - kind, compassionate, patient, explained everything in detail so that I could make an informed decision - and the front desk staff is great! Prices are reasonable, there’s plenty of parking, and they communicate with you really well. Would highly recommend this place for any of your pet’s needs!

I recently took my dog Sheeva to Rose Canyon Animal Hospital to be spayed, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! From start to finish, Dr. Hanks and the entire staff were absolutely amazing.

Dr. Hanks is kind, thorough, and truly cares about his patients. He made me feel completely comfortable and confident about Sheeva’s procedure, answering all my questions with patience and compassion. The staff was so warm and attentive, and I could tell Sheeva was in the best hands possible.

After her surgery, they gave her so much love and made sure I had everything I needed to take care of her at home. She recovered so smoothly thanks to the excellent care she received.

I’m beyond grateful to Dr. Hanks and the Rose Canyon team, they treated Sheeva like one of their own. If you’re looking for a vet who combines skill, compassion, and genuine love for animals, this is the place to go.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommend!

I just lost my dog and am profoundly grateful for the compassion of the people here. A vastly different experience from some other urgent care vets I have been to who just threw a long list of tests at me and urgently tried to get me to spend a lot of money. If your pup is sick and you need to see someone, come here.

We are unbelievably thankful for this animal hospital! Everyone is patient and kind! Going to the vet can be nerve-wracking, but the staff here make it a comfortable experience! The veterinarians are knowledgeable and you can tell they really care! :)

I took my dog Bailey here a few months ago to get her checked out since she’s 15 years old and I could tell she wasn’t feeling as great. The staff was super friendly and very informative. Since then, whenever I had questions they responded through email even without a follow up. When we decided to put our dog Bailey down today they were very kind and gave us lots of time and privacy. I really appreciate all the help the staff has given us the last few months of our dogs life and making the experience as easy as it could have been….

Rose Canyon Animal Hospital has been the best choice for my dog. Bella. Service, cleanliness and professionalism are my highlights, but Doctor Hanks, as he is very acknowledged, patient, empathetic, compassionate, gentle and his brings so much hope and cures Bella every time we stop by the vet. Bella’s life has been a roller coaster since I adopted her because of her past, but doctor Hanks always finds the right solution and brings her back to a healthy stage.
I can’t feel more grateful with everyone working there.

We like Dr. Hanks.  He connects with the animals and they trust him.  We’ve been going to this office since Dr.Michael, who we adored, was in charge.  Probably 10 years ago.  Now, they have late hours with lots of open appointments for sick pets.  Nice, competent staff.

Dr Hank and his staff were friendly and very knowledgeable during a very stressful time with our dog Joker. He even called to follow up afterwards. Our dog is doing better now and we have found our vet doctor. Keep up the amazing work helping people with their fur babies.
Dr. Hank and Katie were exceptional in their care and treatment for our dog.

When we thought our dog had ingested a foreign object and our normal vet was not available, Rose Canyon and provided excellent care. From their front office staff to their doctors, everything was exceptional. Highly recommend if your San Diego pet needs care

My buddy is always well cared for, he is 10 years old and in good health, I never feel like I am getting squeezed for unnecessary treatments, as in other places. Great care for my four legged buddy, a sometimes overly hyper Belgian malinois. The staff is sweet and patient with my beast. Patton and I thank you for your care.

It used to be 5*. They changed everything.  They remodeled 2 times and tore out the lawn. Then they started to raise their prices, every month. Then the procedures got more expensive too. Had to have a minor surgery and even months later still have to massage my dogs incision sites as they did a hack job leaving massive scars across my dogs chest. I wish I got the surgery done elsewhere or by a better vet. With the prices paid, you would think they would know how to stitch. Don't trust this place.

Edit: They responded with some lies about not raising prices, which they did as my pet needed monthy injections increasing in price $5 or more a month, every month, and then deleted it.

We went to another vet office in the area that has our original vet from here and have been nothing but happy with them since. Never have to wait to be seen either.
